description: Main Dart source file for a Flutter application that serves local HTML assets through a webview, manages routing, and provides UI components for navigation and error handling.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget of the application that manages routes and initial screen.

classes.name: ScreensIndex
classes.description: Widget displaying a list of available screens for navigation.

classes.name: HtmlAssetScreen
classes.description: Screen that displays a local HTML asset within a scaffold.

classes.name: HtmlAssetWebView
classes.description: Stateful widget that loads and displays an HTML asset, injecting a base href and handling errors.

classes.name: UnknownRouteScreen
classes.description: Fallback screen displayed for unknown routes.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for each widget, defining its UI layout.

methods.name: _loadHtml
methods.description: Asynchronously loads HTML asset, injects base href, and handles errors.

methods.name: _injectBaseHref
methods.description: Inserts a base href tag and fixes relative paths in the HTML content.

methods.name: _fallbackErrorHtml
methods.description: Generates a minimal HTML page to display loading errors.

methods.name: _escapeHtml
methods.description: Escapes special HTML characters for safe display in error pages.
